name: codeknight
description: Lets Claude check its staged changes, or a diff, with CodeKnight before committing. A hook blocks git commit when a local finding meets the gate. Rule-based checks run on your machine with no account. By default Claude does the AI review itself. A CodeKnight server review is optional.

api_token.title: CodeKnight API token (optional)
api_token.description: Only when you explicitly ask for a CodeKnight server review: the client token that `codeknight login` issues. Leave empty. The default review uses your own Claude and sends nothing.

server_url.title: CodeKnight server URL (optional)
server_url.description: Only when you explicitly ask for a CodeKnight server review: your CodeKnight server (https:// only). Leave empty. The default review uses your own Claude and sends nothing.
